name: app-frosted-user-persona-slide-with-goals-pain-points-and-insight-charts
title: Persona slide on blurred blue-grey with a portrait card, frosted goals cards and green bar insights
whatItIs: A misty blue-grey slide '06 User Persona' with a large rounded portrait of a businessman with name overlay, a quote, three frosted cards (Goals, Pain Points, Needs) and three insight cards with percentage pills over thin green bar charts.
whatItMeans: Calm and credible; frosted panels make dense research feel soft.
techniques: Frost every content card on a blurred backdrop.
Fade the portrait into the card bottom.
Draw insight charts as thin green bars.
Use small icons before card titles.

vocabulary.definition: A portrait with name and role.
